for the Lord is with you.

For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience

For our glory is in this
in the knowledge which we have that our way of life in the world
and most of all in relation to you
has been holy and true in the eyes of God; not in the wisdom of the flesh
but in the grace of God.
